propertySchema.label: Role
propertySchema.description: custom = On {name}. entry = program start. tick = per-frame. Not separate kinds.

propertySchema.label: Super
propertySchema.description: Call the parent implementation (super / base / Parent::). Only when the class Extends a parent.

propertySchema.label: Enum type
propertySchema.description: When set, case values are member names (OK) and emit via EnumMemberAccess

propertySchema.label: Catch type
propertySchema.description: Optional exception type.

propertySchema.label: Catch name
propertySchema.description: Optional catch binding name.

propertySchema.label: Async
propertySchema.description: When on, emit the language async wait. Dimmed where the language has no async wait.

propertySchema.label: Seconds
propertySchema.description: Duration to await asynchronously.

propertySchema.label: Input type
propertySchema.description: Controls parsing and the Value output pin type.

propertySchema.label: JavaScript number conversion
propertySchema.description: parseFloat accepts a numeric prefix; Number converts the entire value. Other targets retain their native conversion.

propertySchema.label: Parameters
propertySchema.description: Comma-separated parameter names.

propertySchema.label: Capture
propertySchema.description: Capture enclosing values. Rust emit uses move when set.

propertySchema.label: Form
propertySchema.description: Class, C# interface, or Rust trait. Not a new node. Hidden where the language has no interface/trait.

propertySchema.label: Extends
propertySchema.description: Parent class from this project. Inherited fields and methods stay on the parent Declare chain â€” use Get / Set / Call.

propertySchema.label: Enum type
propertySchema.description: When set, variable type is this enum; Default is the member name only (e.g. OK)

propertySchema.label: Local initializer
propertySchema.description: Emit the Initializer pin on a scoped local declaration.

propertySchema.label: Local declaration kind
propertySchema.description: JavaScript scoped declaration keyword. Other targets use their native declaration syntax.

propertySchema.label: Native local declaration
propertySchema.description: Go local declaration: inferred :=, explicitly typed var, or readonly typed/untyped const.

propertySchema.label: Role
propertySchema.description: function = named method. constructor / destructor = how that language writes init/teardown. Not separate kinds.

propertySchema.label: Generator
propertySchema.description: Marks the function as a generator. Python def is enough; yield in the body also makes it a generator.

propertySchema.description: Go expression calls belong to one value-expression path and have no execution pins. Use a visible local to reuse a result.

propertySchema.label: Module path
propertySchema.description: stdlib or project module (e.g. enum, iostream, utils)

propertySchema.label: Import style

propertySchema.label: Owner class id

propertySchema.label: Operand evidence

propertySchema.description: Visible expression overflow context; nested contexts keep their own ownership.
